name: @subroh0508/marp-theme-canvas
description: A simple Marp theme with minimal styling

scripts.build: find scss -name '[!_]*.scss' -type f | while read f; do out="css/${f#scss/}"; out="${out%.scss}.css"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"; sass --no-source-map "$f" "$out"; done
scripts.build:html:white: for dir in demo/*/; do marp --allow-local-files --html --theme css/white-canvas.css --input-dir "$dir" --output "docs/public/white-canvas/$(basename "$dir")"; done && marp --allow-local-files --html --theme css/white-canvas.css demo/index.md -o docs/public/white-canvas/index.html
scripts.build:html:black: for dir in demo/*/; do marp --allow-local-files --html --theme css/black-canvas.css --input-dir "$dir" --output "docs/public/black-canvas/$(basename "$dir")"; done && marp --allow-local-files --html --theme css/black-canvas.css demo/index.md -o docs/public/black-canvas/index.html
scripts.build:png:white: for dir in demo/*/; do marp --allow-local-files --images png --browser-timeout 600 --theme css/white-canvas.css --input-dir "$dir" --output "docs/public/white-canvas/$(basename "$dir")"; done
scripts.build:png:black: for dir in demo/*/; do marp --allow-local-files --images png --browser-timeout 600 --theme css/black-canvas.css --input-dir "$dir" --output "docs/public/black-canvas/$(basename "$dir")"; done
scripts.build:site: pnpm build:html:white && pnpm build:html:black && pnpm build:png:white && pnpm build:png:black && pnpm docs:build
